changelog:
- Initial release of attestation-chain-auditor.
- Validates completeness and integrity of attestation chains in AI agent ecosystems.
- Identifies broken links, expired credentials, and missing vouching relationships.
- Audits chains for completeness, expiry, vouching depth, authority legitimacy, and revocation propagation.
- Produces detailed audit reports with chain visualization, link status, circular dependency checks, authority legitimacy, revocation status, and chain strength rating.
